results: Healthcare vulnerability/remediation evidence is served by healthcare-specific and broad exposure-management platforms including HIPAA CyberOps, Virta Labs, Rapid7 and Check Point.
ANYbotics Shift, OxMaint, Boston Dynamics and Da Vinci directly turn autonomous inspection findings into work orders/actions.
Procex/SAP and Sigga directly prioritize maintenance backlog by criticality/readiness; Turkish Asetly and Centra cover maintenance, spares and budget/cost workflows.
Dozuki, Frontline, Workerbase, L2L and Jodoo cover digital work instructions, change propagation, acknowledgment and execution evidence.
RadioCoverage, RadioPlanner and RadioSoft provide DMR/LMR requirement, coverage and system planning/comparison capabilities; proposed decision workspace is insufficiently differentiated.
